correctness.rationale: The two component Boolean structures are definable by x∨¬x and mixed joins recover p. Every Boolean homomorphism is inverse image of a finite function f; two objects are isomorphic iff f maps lie in one S_a×S_b orbit. Fibers are complete orbit invariants by explicit construction, and the stabilizer formula follows by independently permuting unused atoms, equal-size fibers and points within fibers. Sharp failure a>=2,b>=4 and 20-element witness follow from partitions of b. Standalone verification exhaustively checks a=1..4,b=1..5, 1794 maps, 48 actual two-sided permutation orbits and two 20-element operation tables. Finite cases corroborate, rather than replace, the general argument.

value.rationale: A published exact enumeration and isomorphism test for a natural algebraic semantics of paraconsistent weak Kleene logic is contradicted by a smallest 20-point model. The corrected theorem supplies complete, closed-form, nontrivial isomorphism and automorphism classification for all two-component sizes and the sharp parameter boundary where the published formula does work. This is substantive correction of a motivated object, not an arbitrary slice, textbook deduction alone, or merely code novelty.
